SELECT n.service_name, n.cn normal_spans, coalesce(a.ca,0) abnormal_spans FROM (SELECT service_name, count(*) cn FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1) n LEFT JOIN (SELECT service_name, count(*) ca FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1) a USING(service_name) ORDER BY n.cn DESC

content.text: The user-facing slowdowns are at ui-dashboard on admin-order, orderOther refresh, travel2 trips/left and travelPlan endpoints. Next I'll confirm the seat path with one slow travel-plan trace.

input.query: WITH s AS (SELECT trace_id FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND span_name LIKE 'POST /api/v1/travelplanservice/travelPlan/quickest%' AND duration>200e6 LIMIT 1) SELECT t.service_name, t.span_name, t.attr_span_kind, round(t.duration/1e6,1) ms FROM abnormal_traces t JOIN s USING(trace_id) ORDER BY t.time

content.text: The trace confirms the chain: seat's left_tickets is slow because its POST to order-other is slow. Next I'll check which services call seat, so the propagation edges are right.

input.query: SELECT p.service_name caller, c.service_name callee, c.span_name, count(*) n, round(approx_quantile(c.duration/1e6,0.5),1) child_p50, round(approx_quantile(c.duration/1e6,0.95),1) child_p95 FROM abnormal_traces c JOIN abnormal_traces p ON c.parent_span_id = p.span_id AND c.trace_id=p.trace_id WHERE c.service_name IN ('ts-seat-service','ts-order-other-service','ts-admin-order-service') AND c.attr_span_kind='Server' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

input.reflection: Findings: single root cause at ts-order-other-service. Its SELECT ts.orders_other DB client spans jump to ~415ms (findByAccountId, findAll, findByTravelDateAndTrainNumber) while its CPU, memory, and restarts stay normal. Propagation: order-other is called by ui-dashboard (refresh, p95 3.8->426ms), admin-order-service (GET adminorder, p95 ~1s, ui adminorder p95 949ms), and seat-service (POST orders_other/tickets, p95 215ms via parent-child join). Seat's own time is flat; its slowness is inherited and reaches travel2-service (-> seat calls p95 221ms) and travel-plan-service. Missing spans in preserve/security/delivery/assurance/inside-payment/station-food are low-volume flows absent in abnormal, not evidenced as faults. Restarts unchanged. No hubble metrics. Answer: database_call_slow at ts-order-other-service.
